name: uwezo-fund-app

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon && cd .. && mkdir -p dist-apk && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk dist-apk/UwezoFund.apk && cp -f dist-apk/UwezoFund.apk dist-apk/UwezoFund-debug.apk && ls -lh dist-apk/UwezoFund.apk
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon && cd .. && mkdir -p dist-apk && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk dist-apk/UwezoFund.apk && cp -f dist-apk/UwezoFund.apk dist-apk/UwezoFund-1.2.2.apk && printf '%s\n' '{"versionCode":65,"versionName":"1.2.2","apkUrl":"https://loans.uwezo.go.ke/uwezo-app/UwezoFund.apk","notes":"Fix Firebase crash; per-email LMS DB; application numbers; constituency name"}' > dist-apk/version.json && ls -lh dist-apk/UwezoFund.apk

description: Uwezo Fund PWA — Majuu, loans, website links, phone OTP chat, App QR login
